mapper.insert: insert into tb_slip_header ( slip_id, slip_date, slip_type, description, resolution_id, status, created_by, created_at ) values ( #{slip_id}, #{slip_date}, #{slip_type}, #{description}, #{resolution_id}, #{status}, #{created_by}, now() )

select count(*) + 1 as serial from tb_slip_detail where slip_id = #{slip_id}
INSERT INTO tb_slip_detail( slip_id, detail_id, acc_code, dr_cr, amount, summary, created_at ) VALUES( #{slip_id}, #{detail_id}, #{acc_code}, #{dr_cr}, #{amount}, #{remark}, now() )
